PRIVACY_POLICY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY_POLICY.INTRODUCTION_CONTENT: We are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
PRIVACY_POLICY.INFORMATION_COLLECTED_CONTENT: We may collect the following types of information:
PRIVACY_POLICY.INFO_ITEM_1: Personal information: name, email, phone number
PRIVACY_POLICY.INFO_ITEM_2: Booking information: check-in date, check-out date, room number
PRIVACY_POLICY.INFO_ITEM_3: Payment information: payment method, card number (encrypted)
PRIVACY_POLICY.INFO_ITEM_4: Usage information: booking history, system interactions
PRIVACY_POLICY.USE_OF_INFORMATION_CONTENT: We use information to provide services, process bookings, improve user experience, and send important notifications.
PRIVACY_POLICY.DATA_PROTECTION_CONTENT: We use advanced security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
PRIVACY_POLICY.CONTACT_CONTENT: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please contact us via email or phone.

TERMS_OF_SERVICE.TITLE: Terms of Service
TERMS_OF_SERVICE.ACCEPTANCE_CONTENT: By using our service, you agree to these terms and conditions.
TERMS_OF_SERVICE.USE_OF_SERVICE_CONTENT: You agree to use the service lawfully and must not:
TERMS_OF_SERVICE.USE_ITEM_1: Use the service for illegal purposes
TERMS_OF_SERVICE.USE_ITEM_2: Attempt unauthorized access to the system
TERMS_OF_SERVICE.USE_ITEM_3: Harm or interfere with service operations
TERMS_OF_SERVICE.USE_ITEM_4: Use other users' information without permission
TERMS_OF_SERVICE.BOOKING_CONTENT: All bookings must be confirmed and paid according to regulations. We reserve the right to refuse bookings for valid reasons.
TERMS_OF_SERVICE.PAYMENT_CONTENT: Payment must be made on time as specified. We accept payment methods listed on the website.
TERMS_OF_SERVICE.CANCELLATION_CONTENT: Cancellation policy applies according to specific regulations for each room type and service package.
TERMS_OF_SERVICE.LIABILITY_CONTENT: We are not liable for any damages arising from the use of the service, except as required by law.
TERMS_OF_SERVICE.CONTACT_CONTENT: If you have questions about the terms of service, please contact us.
